app.title: folio-lab
app.tagline: Backtest portfolios that mix Thai funds, Thai stocks, and global ETFs in one place
app.disclaimer: Past performance does not guarantee future returns. Nothing here is investment advice.

startAmount.label: Starting amount
startAmount.hint: The amount assumed to be invested at the start of the period

endBalance.label: Ending balance
endBalance.hint: What the starting amount grows into by the end of the selected period

cagr.label: Annualised return
cagr.hint: The average yearly growth rate that would produce the same result if it were identical every year. Higher is better

stdev.label: Annualised volatility
stdev.hint: How far returns swing from their average. Higher means a bumpier ride

bestYear.label: Best year
bestYear.hint: The best calendar year in the period, counting full years only

worstYear.label: Worst year
worstYear.hint: The worst calendar year in the period, counting full years only. It shows how much a bad year hurts

maxDrawdown.label: Maximum drawdown
maxDrawdown.hint: The deepest fall from a previous peak before recovering to that peak

sharpe.label: Sharpe
sharpe.hint: Return earned above a risk-free deposit per unit of volatility. Higher means better paid for the risk

sortino.label: Sortino
sortino.hint: Like Sharpe, but it only penalises downward swings. Useful if losses worry you more than bumpiness

summary.heading: Backtest summary
summary.noDownside: Cannot be calculated because there are no losing months
